hypothesis: Region-scale NFHL claims are copied onto every parcel with per-parcel provenance stamped as if each row were an independently sourced measurement about that parcel, rather than a Derivation from one regional bulk load.
verdictSummary: All 62,256 Bastrop flood-hazard-fact atoms share one county-level bulk provenance signature (one sourceCitation, one sourceVintage, one adapter, one regional table). Claim values vary per parcel (4 flood zones) but reasoningChain.reasoningKind is observed on every row and each atom carries its own evaluatedAt/fetchedAt as though independently measured. The sourceCitation text honestly names the bulk county load; the semantic misclassification is reasoningKind observed plus per-parcel timestamps without inputAtoms or provenanceClass Derivation.

instrument.sampleMethod: ORDER BY md5(entity_id) LIMIT 20 (pseudo-random within county prefix range)
instrument.envCredentials: DATABASE_URL and CORTEX_DATABASE_URL unset in shell; query executed via Neon MCP read-only run_sql

writePathRead.mechanism: One provenance object is built per county run (sourceAdapter fema-nfhl-bulk-v1, sourceUrl tx_fema_nfhl_flood_zone, county-scoped sourceCitation, single observedAt timestamp) and passed to buildAtomsForFloodHazardPlan, which mints one atom per parcel with reasoningChain.reasoningKind observed.

findings.claim: Provenance metadata is county-batch identical, not per-parcel independent
findings.evidence: 62,256 atoms; 1 distinct sourceCitation; 1 bulk provenance signature excluding batch timestamps
findings.secondMechanism: Parcels applied in multiple county runs with different citations
findings.rejectedBecause: Only 2 fetched_at batch stamps within one apply; sourceCitation identical across both batches

findings.claim: Claim values are per-parcel (spatial join), provenance stamps are not
findings.evidence: 4 distinct floodZone values county-wide; AE/A/X/AO parcels share identical sourceCitation and reasoningKind observed
findings.secondMechanism: All parcels happen to fall in same zone
findings.rejectedBecause: Zone distribution spans X (93.5%), A, AE, AO

findings.claim: Each row presents as independently observed, not derived from regional bulk
findings.evidence: reasoningChain.reasoningKind observed on every sampled row; per-row evaluatedAt/fetchedAt; no inputAtoms; no provenanceClass field populated
findings.secondMechanism: sourceCitation honesty makes provenance class correct for consumers who read prose
findings.rejectedBecause: Contract targets machine-readable provenance class; store audit Q5 shows provenanceScope/inputAtoms starved at zero in production sample

findings.claim: source_url is not a per-parcel authority URL
findings.evidence: All rows: source_url and body.sourceUrl = tx_fema_nfhl_flood_zone (internal table name), not FEMA MapServer endpoint
findings.secondMechanism: URL is dereferenced internally to regional polygons
findings.note: Consistent with bulk derivation; does not support independent per-parcel fetch narrative

whatWouldRefute: Distinct sourceCitation or sourceVintage per parcel in a 20-row md5 sample
reasoningKind derivation or synthesis with inputAtoms pointing at regional NFHL ingest
Per-parcel fetched_at spread matching individual FEMA API query times rather than 2 batch stamps
whatRemainsUnmeasured: Whether other counties show the same pattern (write path is county-agnostic; mechanism claim extrapolates; rate unmeasured outside 48021)
Whether ~13.5M store-wide flood-hazard-fact rows from other county applies share this shape (Bastrop is one of 177 landed counties per B1 close)
